The browser you are using is not supported by this website. All versions of Internet Explorer are no longer supported, either by us or Microsoft (read more here: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/windows/end-of-ie-support).

Please use a modern browser to fully experience our website, such as the newest versions of Edge, Chrome, Firefox or Safari etc.

About this website

This version of the Lund University's international website was launched in June 2020. As part of the transition, the website was given a new look.

The site works best with the following browsers:

  • Google Chrome
  • Firefox
  • Microsoft Edge
  • Safari

About accessibility

We are committed to ensuring that as many people as possible can access and use this website and its content. In our accessibility work we aim to follow the guidelines set out by the Agency for Digital Government (DIGG) and the W3C Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI).

As a part of this, we use the services of Funka to test and improve the accessibility of the website.

  • More about the accessibility of this website
  • Accessibility statement for this website
  • Funka website

About cookies

This website uses cookies. A cookie is a piece of information that is stored on your computer when you visit a website.

  • Our cookie policy

If you have content questions or feedback

We are always working to improve our website. We welcome feedback, questions and comments about its content. 

Please contact the site editors using one of the methods below:

  • Contact a specific page manager. You will find their email address at the bottom of each page.
  • Email us at editors [at] kommunikation [dot] lu [dot] se (editors[at]kommunikation[dot]lu[dot]se).
